messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High 502/504 rate detected at API gateway (us-east-1). 5xx rate = 8.3% over the last 5m. Top affected route: /v1/generate. Impact: elevated latency + partial customer failures. Paging @alice @bob @carlos. :rotating_light:

alice: acked, joining. grabbing logs and metrics now.

bob: oncall-api here — I see a sudden uptick of `connection reset by peer` from apigw -> inference-svc-1 nodes starting ~1763141400. p95 latency for /v1/generate jumped to 1.8s.

carlos: adding context: yesterday we rolled inference v2 to 30% traffic in us-east. wonder if unhealthy KV cache or model process OOM. checking pod restarts.

dana: monitoring note — several paying enterprise customers are seeing >10% failure for chat endpoints (support tickets incoming). marking customer-impact high.

alice: quick check: backend pod CPU spiking, some kube events show `OOMKilled` on inference-svc-1-2 and 1-5. not all nodes.

sre-ops: mitigation options: (1) ephemeral traffic redistribution to inference-svc-2 pool, (2) scale replica count up, (3) revert rollout. Which to try first?

bob: traffic redistribution first — do a weighted route shift to the healthy pool and drain problematic pods. command: `redwood route update apigw --route /v1/generate --weights v2:10,v1:90 --region us-east-1`

carlos: doing it now. applying `kubectl patch` to change weights and adding drain annotation on pods matching `inference-svc-1` to avoid new requests.

(ops-bot): route update accepted — new weights v2:10, v1:90. Draining 2 pods in inference-svc-1.

dana: visible error rate dropping in us-east edge from 8.3% -> 3.1% over 90s. latency trending down. still some tail errors for legacy clients.

alice: repro logs show `malloc` failures in model loader on certain quantized shards. looks like a regression in the v2 loader.

sre-ops: recommendation: rollback v2 rollout and scale fallback pool to absorb traffic while we hotfix.

bob: initiating rollback to v1 (traffic -> v1 100%). command: `redwood rollout revert inference:v2 --region us-east-1 --confirm`

(ops-bot): rollback started. traffic now rerouted to inference-v1.

carlos: scaled inference-v1 from 6 -> 12 replicas to absorb spike.

dana: customer-impact update: ticket rate stabilized, no new enterprise escalations in last 10m.

alice: monitoring — 5xx now ~0.9%, p95 back to normal. tagging incident for postmortem.

liz: I'm taking lead for incident review and postmortem. handoff from alice/bob/carlos. adding followups: alert tuning, canary resource limits, and better OOM guard in v2 loader.

alice: noted. saving logs and bumping to #postmortems. closing live triage. :white_check_mark:
